findings.affected_requirement: FR-017, AC-7, Constitution III and IV, plan fail-closed atomic persistence and ScanRun terminal-state requirements
findings.evidence: Provider-derived CodeUnits and CodeUnitFrameworks are attached to the tracked ScanRun before the final transaction (notably lines 456 and 475), and Complete is called before PersistCompletedProfileAsync at line 579. If cancellation or an unexpected exception occurs after attachments but before final persistence, the outer handlers call ordinary SaveChangesAsync on the same tracker, which can persist those partial children together with Aborted or Failed. If cancellation occurs inside PersistCompletedProfileAsync after Complete, the transaction rolls back but the tracked ScanRun remains Completed in memory; the outer cancellation handler skips terminalization because it only handles Profiling, leaving the durable row Profiling. The cancellation test throws from the provider before any child is attached, so neither late path is covered.
findings.correction_outcome: Keep all provider-derived graph state detached until the single final transaction, or clear the tracker before every terminal-state recovery. Centralize late failure and cancellation recovery so it rolls back, clears tracking, reloads the durable Profiling row in a fresh unit of work, and writes the contract-defined Failed or Aborted state with CancellationToken.None. Add RED regression tests for cancellation after at least one mapped Code Unit and cancellation during final persistence; each must prove a terminal durable ScanRun and zero persisted Code Units, frameworks, Edges, unresolved relationships, summaries, and candidate-derived structural rows.
